title: An app blocker alternative for people whose app blocker didn't stick.

copy.instagram_caption:
An app blocker alternative for people whose app blocker didn't stick.

If you turned yours off, you're not weak. Walls and timers are all or nothing. When they slip, you're back where you started, plus guilt.

DeRot does something smaller. When a feed has wound you up, it pauses your apps while you reset with a few calming breaths, then gets out of the way. You're never locked out.

Coming soon to iPhone. Launch list: link in bio.
